781: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ; ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
O God, have mercy on Nanak, that my eyes may behold Your sight everywhere. ॥1॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਨ ਦੀਜਹਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
O beloved God, imperishable Lord, if I were given millions of ears, with them I would hear Your praises.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Hearing His praises again and again, this mind becomes pure and the noose of spiritual death is cut.
ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ. ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਸਗਲ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Remembering the imperishable Lord, Death's noose is cut, joy upon joy fills the heart, and spiritual understanding arises.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Repeat the Lord's Name day and night; through the Name attention stays fixed in spiritual poise.
ਕਲਮਲ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Keeping God's Name in mind, all sins and pains are burnt away and the mind's evil thinking is destroyed.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Nanak says: O God, if You show mercy, Your praises may be heard with these ears. ॥2॥
ਕਰੋੜਿ ਹਸਤ. ਤੇਰੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਚਰਣ ਚਲਹਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
O God, the millions of hands of those You favour serve You, and their millions of feet walk on Your path.
ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ. ਨਾਵ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜੋ ਚੜੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Devotion to the Lord is the boat across the world-ocean; whoever boards it, the Lord carries across.
ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Whoever remembered the Lord crossed the world-ocean, and the Lord fulfils all that person's wishes.
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਗਏ. ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ; ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
Great vices leave that person, comforts arise within, and unbroken music plays, as it were.
ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ, ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲੇ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ. ਅਪਾਰਗਿ ॥
That person obtained every wish of the heart. O God, the worth of Your creation cannot be told.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ; ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Nanak says: O God, have mercy on me too, that my mind may ever walk on Your path. ॥3॥
ਏਹੋ ਵਰੁ. ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Staying in the Name is that person's blessing, glory and wealth; it is that person's great fortune.
ਏਹੋ ਰੰਗੁ. ਏਹੋ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
This is that person's pleasure and enjoyment of all delights: that the mind is joined to the Lord's feet,
ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਰਣੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੇ; ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
that the mind is absorbed in God's feet and stays in the refuge of the Sustainer, the cause of the world.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
O my God, my Master, Merciful to the meek, every gift we have is given by You.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
O my Beloved, Ocean of comfort, by Your grace the mind of me, without virtue, has woken in the company of saints from the sleep of attachment to Maya.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੑੀ; ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
Nanak says: O God, when You showed mercy, my mind was absorbed in Your lotus feet. ॥4॥3॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ. ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
The Lord made this body a temple for repeating His Name; in it saints and devotees sing the Lord's praises.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਸਗਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Remembering their Master, God, at all times, the saints have all their sins removed.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ. ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Singing the Lord's praises and the pure Bani of His praise, the saints have attained the highest spiritual state in this body.
ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ; ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
They have praised the Lord whose form cannot be described; His praise is exceedingly sweet and brings spiritual poise.
ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
In that body-temple the auspicious union and the lasting moment come when the unshakeable foundation of His praise is laid.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak: within the one on whom God is merciful, great spiritual strength arises. ॥1॥
ਆਨੰਦਾ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
In the body-temple of the one in whose mind the Lord comes to dwell, the instruments of bliss ever play, as it were.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਝੂਠਾ. ਰਾਮ ॥
All doubt, fear and falsehood are destroyed within, and repeating the eternal Name through the Guru becomes that person's highest duty.
ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ; ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
Turning to the Guru, that person ever utters the unbroken Bani of praise; hearing the Lord's praise again and again, mind and body come alive.
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਣਿ ਆਏ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
All comforts gathered within the one whom God made His own.
ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
The one who comes to love the Lord's Name has storehouses full of the nine treasures in the heart-home, as it were.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਦੇ, ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
Nanak: the servant whose full fortune awakens never forgets God. ॥2॥
ਛਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ; ਸਗਲੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
The one on whose head the Sovereign Lord placed His hand had all the burning of vice destroyed within.
ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਠਾ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
The camp of pain and sin within was pulled down, and that person's life's purpose was fulfilled.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਬਲਾਇਆ; ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਫਲਿਆ ॥
The Lord God gave the command, the curse of Maya ended, and the righteousness of remembering the eternal Name began to grow within.
782: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ. ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸੋਵਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਖਲਿਆ ॥
Ever meditate on that God of yours, sleeping, sitting and standing.
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
The one who meditates sees that Lord, treasure of virtues and ocean of comfort, pervading water, land and sky.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Servant Nanak: that person stays in God's refuge and sees no other support but Him. ॥3॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਬਨਿਆ. ਬਨੁ ਤਾਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Since I touched the feet of the Sovereign Lord, my body and my heart, everything, have become beautiful.
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ. ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸੇ; ਗੁਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Since I began singing songs of the Lord's praise, my mind has become beautiful and all my friends, my senses, have come alive spiritually.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Singing God's praises and remembering the eternal Lord, all wishes are fulfilled.
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ. ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ; ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
Those who fall at the Guru's feet stay ever awake against Maya's attacks, and a spirited spiritual life stays within them.
ਕਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ; ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
The one on whom the Master, Giver of comforts, cast His gracious glance has had this world and the next made beautiful.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
Nanak prays: ever repeat the Name of the Lord who has sustained this life and this body. ॥4॥4॥7॥
ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੋ. ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Remembering the Lord's Name, one crosses the world-ocean full of countless fears.
ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
The Lord's feet are a beautiful ship; the one who, meeting the Guru, worships the Lord's feet, the Guru carries across.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ. ਬਹੁੜਿ, ਨ ਮਰੀਐ; ਚੂਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Through the Guru's Word one crosses over, does not suffer spiritual death again and again, and the round of birth and death ends.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ; ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Through the Guru's Word I accept as good whatever the Lord does; when this path is taken, the mind settles in poise.
ਦੂਖ ਨ. ਭੂਖ ਨ, ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
In the refuge of God, the ocean of comfort, no pain, hunger or disease can take hold.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the one who, remembering the Lord again and again, is dyed in His love wipes out every worry of the mind. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
The bride in whose heart the saints made the Lord's Name-mantra firm has won the Lord over by her love.
ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਿਆ; ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ. ਰਾਮ ॥
She offered her dear mind to the Master, and in return the Master gave her everything.
ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
The Master made her His own servant, her wandering after Maya ended, and she found her rest in this body-temple made by the Lord.
ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Remember the eternal Lord, and bliss will stay within you; the bride who remembers the Name never strays from His feet.
ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
The bride who has formed deep kinship with the Lord's Name and virtues becomes fortunate and ever wedded to her Husband.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
Nanak says: those who, dyed in the Lord's love, remember His Name stay soaked in the great relish of love. ॥2॥
ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ; ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
O friend, now bliss, joy and delight ever stay in my heart-home,
ਆਪਨੜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ; ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
for my own dear God Himself has made my life beautiful and made me an honoured bride.
ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ. ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
O friend, from His own poised love the Lord becomes merciful to His servants and does not dwell on their virtues and faults.
ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
The Lord hugs His servants to Himself and enshrines His Name in their hearts.
ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
O friend, pride, attachment and the intoxication of Maya, which overpower the whole world, He Himself in His mercy has removed from me.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ; ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Nanak says: by His grace I am crossing the terrifying world-ocean, and all my affairs are being accomplished. ॥3॥
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਹੋ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
O friends, ever sing the praises of the Sustainer of the world; He fulfils every wish.
ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ; ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Meeting the Guru and remembering the all-pervading One, life becomes fruitful.
ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਅਨੇਕ ਰਵਿਆ; ਸਰਬ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
O friends, that one God pervades the many and the whole world; all this expanse is God Himself.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮੋ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ; ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
God is revealing Himself in all the world; repeating His Name, one sees Him alone everywhere.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
O friends, no place is empty of Him; He is present everywhere in water, land and sky.
783: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸੇ; ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
Nanak, say: those whom He Himself joins to His feet blossom with bliss, beholding the All-pervading. ॥4॥5॥8॥
ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who, in the Guru's refuge, found bliss repeating the Name of the great Lord had their bodies become a city for the imperishable Lord to dwell in.
ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
The Creator Himself settled that body-city for His dwelling, and they ever obtained the wishes of their hearts.
ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸਿਖ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ॥
Those whose bodies the Creator made ready for His dwelling enjoyed all comforts; those Sikhs, sons and brothers of the Guru, stay ever cheerful.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
Those fortunate ones ever sing the praises of the all-pervading Lord, and their life's purpose is fulfilled.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਆਪੇ ਰਖਾ; ਆਪਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
The Master Himself is ever their protector; as parents watch over a son, He Himself is their father and mother.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Nanak says: be ever a sacrifice to the Guru, who by the gift of the Name has made this body-place beautiful. ॥1॥
ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ਸੋਹੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
In the body-city where, by the Guru's grace, the Lord's Name comes to dwell, all the senses take on a beautiful spiritual life.
ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ; ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Within it the saints and devotees remember the Lord's Name, and the noose of spiritual death is cut.
ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Those who, in the Guru's refuge, remembered the Lord's Name had the noose of spiritual death cut by the imperishable God.
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ; ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
All the spiritual virtues needed were made complete within them, and their heart's wishes were fulfilled.
ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ; ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Remembering the Name through the Guru, the saints and devotees rest in comfort and enjoy spiritual bliss; all pain, suffering and doubt within them are destroyed.
ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: I am ever a sacrifice to the perfect Guru, who through his Word has made beautiful the lives of those in his refuge. ॥2॥
ਦਾਤਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
In the one on whom, by the Guru's grace, the full gift of the Name comes from the Lord, that gift ever keeps growing,
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ; ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
for the Lord of boundless power has Himself placed His hand on that person's head.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
From the beginning of the world the Lord has been the protector of His devotees and merciful to them.
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
That God Himself has sustained all beings and settled them all in comfort.
ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
The Master's glory fills all the ten directions; the worth of His greatness cannot be told.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
Nanak says: be ever a sacrifice to the Guru, who lays within people the unshakeable foundation of remembering the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
In that unshakeable city one ever hears discourse on knowing and attuning to the all-pervading Lord.
ਅਨਹਦ ਚੋਜ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨ; ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
In the saints' body-city there rises an unbroken, powerful sound of the wondrous plays and praise of the Lord, who ends His devotees' births and deaths.
ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ; ਸੰਤ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
There the Lord's unbroken praise goes on, His virtues as the world's source are reflected on, and the saints ever share godly discourse.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ. ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਟਹਿ; ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
The saints there remember the Lord's Name and cut away all the filth of vice; the Name removes all their sins.
ਤਹ. ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋੁਨੀਐ ॥
Dwelling there, there is no birth or death, no coming and going; one does not fall into the species again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
Nanak, say: dwelling in that city one meets the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, by whose grace every wish is fulfilled. ॥4॥6॥9॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜਿ. ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
It is the Lord's age-old nature to stand by His saints in their work; He Himself has come to accomplish it.
ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਤਾਲੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ; ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
In the one within whom the Lord's life-giving Name-water takes full effect, the body-earth becomes beautiful and the heart-pool becomes beautiful.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ. ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
In the one brimming with the life-giving Name-water, the Lord brings every effort to raise the spiritual life to completion, and all wishes are fulfilled.
ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਲਾਥੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
That person's glory spreads through the whole world, and every worry and regret ends.
ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਜਸੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
The Vedas and Puranas too have sung this praise of the all-pervading, unshakeable, imperishable Lord.
ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the Transcendent Lord has ever kept His age-old nature: the one on whom He shows mercy begins to remember His Name. ॥1॥
ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ, ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੇ; ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
To those who sing His praises the Creator has given a gift that is, as it were, all nine treasures and all miraculous powers; it never runs short.
784: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Eating, sharing and enjoying this gift of the Name, they have spiritual bliss; the Creator's gift keeps increasing.
ਦਾਤਿ ਸਵਾਈ. ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The gift keeps growing and never runs out; through it they meet the Lord, the Knower of hearts.
ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਠੇ; ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
Millions of obstacles on life's journey all flee from their path, and no pain comes near them.
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
All hunger for Maya ends within them; coolness prevails, and the many joys of spiritual poise remain.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ; ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Nanak: they ever sing the praises of the Master, whose greatness is wondrous to tell. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ. ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ; ਮਾਣਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Joining His saints to His feet is the Lord's own work, and He alone has ever done it; mortal man has no power to do it.
ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
By His grace His devotees sing the Lord's praises, ever acclaim Him, and grow beautiful in spiritual life.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਨਦ ਉਪਜੇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
Singing the Lord's praises, waves of bliss arise within them, and in the holy congregation their love with Him remains.
ਜਿਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਾਲ ਕੇਰਾ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
The Lord who has ever made the effort of filling the pool of the saints' hearts with the Name-water — I am not able to describe His greatness.
ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਿਰਿਆ; ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
In such a saintly heart, full of the life-giving Name-water, are the sixty-eight pilgrimage places and the greatest, purest good deeds.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Nanak: giving the support of the Guru's Word to purify great sinners has ever been the Master's age-old nature. ॥3॥
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
My Creator Lord is the treasure of all virtues; there is no one who can fully praise Him.
ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
His saints ever pray at His door: O Master, keep blessing us with Your Name, the supreme relish;
ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਇਕ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
be merciful and keep giving us Your Name; do not leave our hearts even for a moment.
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਉਚਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ; ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
Utter the praises of the Sustainer with your tongue; He should be praised at all times.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮ ਸੇਤੀ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
The one who comes to love the Lord's Name has mind and body ever soaked in the life-giving Name-water.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ; ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦॥
Nanak prays: beholding the Lord, spiritual life is received and every wish is fulfilled. ॥4॥7॥10॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲੜਾ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
My Master, the Lord, is a dear friend who speaks sweet words.
ਹਉ ਸੰਮਲਿ ਥਕੀ ਜੀ; ਓਹੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥
I have grown weary trying to recall a harsh word from Him; He never speaks harshly.
ਕਉੜਾ ਬੋਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ. ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ; ਅਉਗਣੁ ਕੋ. ਨ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
The perfect Lord, full of all virtues, does not know how to speak harshly, for He keeps none of our faults in mind.
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਏ; ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ. ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
Purifier of sinners is said to be His age-old nature, and He does not let even a particle of anyone's effort go to waste.
ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਨੇਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
My Friend dwells in every body and in all beings, nearest of the near to each one.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Servant Nanak ever stays in His refuge; my Friend, the Lord, gives spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Beholding the infinite Lord, I am filled with wonder.
ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀ; ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪਗ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
He is my beautiful Master; I am the dust of His lotus feet.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਠੰਢੀ ਥੀਵਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Beholding God I come alive and become calm; there is none equal to Him.
ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
He was at the beginning of the world, He will be at its end, and He is now; He dwells in water, land and sky.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ; ਭਵਜਲ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
Meditating on His lotus feet the ocean can be crossed; countless beings have crossed the world-ocean.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਤੇਰਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: O perfect Transcendent Lord, I have come to Your refuge; Your being has no end and no near or far shore. ॥2॥
ਹਉ ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
The beloved Lord is the support of our life; I will not let go of His remembrance even for the blink of an eye.
ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੀ; ਸਾਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
The Guru has told me this unshakeable teaching about union with the unreachable Lord.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਨਾ. ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Only when, meeting the Guru, one receives the gift of the Name can the Lord's Name be repeated; the one who repeats it is rid of all pain from birth to death.
ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
Within that person the many comforts and joys of spiritual poise arise, and the knot of ego is destroyed.
785: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ. ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੋ ॥
The Lord is within all beings and also apart from all; though in all, He stays untouched by attachment and envy.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Nanak: His servants ever stay in the Lord's refuge; the beloved Lord is the support of every mind. ॥3॥
ਮੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Searching and searching, I have found that home of the Lord which never wavers.
ਸਭਿ ਅਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਡਿਠੇ ਜੀਉ; ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ, ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
When I saw that all things of the world are perishable, I fixed my mind on God's lotus feet.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ. ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ; ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
God is imperishable; I have become His servant. He never dies, and never comes or goes in birth and death.
ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕਾਮ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
Righteousness, wealth, desire and all such things are present in Him; He fulfils every wish the mind conceives.
ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ; ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
From ancient times the Shrutis and Simritis have sung the Creator's praises, and adepts, seekers and sages have meditated on Him.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
Nanak: the Master is the treasure of mercy; by great fortune one takes His refuge and sings the Lord's praises. ॥4॥1॥11॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਵਾਰ ਸੂਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਪਰ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
The soul-bride absorbed in the safflower-red dress of the world's lovely things is unfortunate; she goes off, as it were, to enjoy another's husband.
ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ. ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
In love of Maya she is being plundered, for she forsakes the Husband-Lord dwelling in her own heart-home.
ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ; ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵਧਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
The one who has enjoyed the world's things as sweet finds disease growing in the mind from these many cravings.
ਸੁਧੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
She leaves her own true Husband, the Lord, and so becomes separated from Him.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
The bride who walks in the Guru's command has her mind turned back from worldly pleasures; adorned with love for the Lord, she stays dyed in Him.
ਸਹਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Enshrining the Lord's Name in her heart and resting in poise, she enjoys her eternal Husband.
ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ; ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
The bride who walks in His command is ever wedded; the Creator has united her with Himself.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the bride who has attained the eternal Lord as Husband is wedded for ever. ॥1॥
ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਏ; ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
O poor bride in love with the safflower's bright red, ever keep the Husband-Lord in mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: thus you will make your life beautiful, and your family too will be saved along with you. ॥2॥
God Himself made the whole world, from the sky to the underworld, as His throne.
By His command He made the earth a place for beings to practise righteousness.
ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ; ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
O eternal One, Merciful to the meek, You Yourself create and Yourself destroy.
ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਦਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
O Lord, Your command is wondrous and none can turn it; You bring sustenance to all beings.
You Yourself are present everywhere, and You Yourself sustain all beings. ॥1॥
ਸੂਹਬ ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
O bride in red dress, if you accept the eternal Name, you will become a wedded bride.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈ, ਰੂਪੁ ਚੜੀ ਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ; ਦੂਜਾ. ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Win over your Guru, and a deep colour of the Name will come upon you; there is no other place to get this colour.
ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਤੂ, ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
In the Guru's refuge, make such an adornment that is never soiled, and your love for the Lord will remain day and night.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਹੈ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ. ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ, ਖਸਮੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak: what other sign is there of a wedded bride? The true Name within her, her face radiant with the Name, and she stays joined to her Husband-Lord. ॥1॥
ਲੋਕਾ ਵੇ. ਹਉ ਸੂਹਵੀ; ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
O people, I am merely one in red dress; I merely wear red clothes,
ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਰਹੀ ॥
but the Husband is not found by dress alone; I have grown weary of dressing up.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
Nanak: only those who have listened to the Guru's teaching have found the Husband.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੨॥
When the bride reaches the state of accepting that whatever pleases God comes to pass, in this way she meets her Husband-Lord. ॥2॥
786: ਹੁਕਮੀ. ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ; ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
By His command God made this creation, this world of many kinds.
ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ; ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
O True One, unseen and infinite, it cannot be grasped how mighty Your command is.
ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Some You join to the Guru's Word and unite with Yourself;
ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
casting off the vice of ego, they are dyed in Your Name and become pure.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ. ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
O Lord, whoever You unite meets You, and that one alone trades in Truth. ॥2॥
ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
O bride in love with the safflower's red, to those within whom are attachment to Maya and evil thinking, the world looks bright and alluring;
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਭੁ. ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ; ਜਿਉ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ. ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
but this safflower colour is false and perishes in a moment, just as a tree's shade does not stay.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਜੀਠ, ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
The bride who turns to the Guru is dyed the fast red of the Name, as if in the colour of madder.
ਉਲਟੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ; ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
Turning back from Maya, she settles in the Lord's own being, and the Lord's ambrosial Name dwells in her mind.
ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Nanak: be a sacrifice to your Guru, meeting whom one sings the Lord's praises. ॥1॥
ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਕੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
As bright red draws a woman's mind, so vice draws the soul-bride; caught in its pull, the Husband-Lord cannot be found.
ਇਸੁ ਲਹਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
This bright colour of vice takes no time to fade; know that the bride caught in love of Maya sits widowed.
ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਦੁੰਮਣੀ; ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਇ ॥
The bride lured by Maya's bright dress is ignorant, and her mind ever wavers.
ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
The bride who, through the true Word, makes the fast red of the Lord's Name her colour, and through fear and love of the Lord makes her adornment,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
and who walks in love of the Guru, Nanak, is ever wedded. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਆਪਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
God Himself created all beings, and He Himself knows their worth.
ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪਈ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
His end cannot be found; through the Guru's Word He Himself gives understanding.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
Attachment to Maya is pitch darkness; in it a person forgets the true path and wanders elsewhere.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
The self-willed do not find life's true destination; they are born and die again and again.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ; ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; all creation moves in His will. ॥3॥
ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ. ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
The bride absorbed in Maya's bright dress is like an unfaithful woman who forsakes her Husband, God, and loves another man.
ਓਸੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ. ਸਦਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
She has neither good conduct nor discipline; she ever speaks falsehood and is ruined by her self-willed deeds.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
The one with destiny written from the Lord's court meets the Guru, her protector;
ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਧਰੇ; ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
then she takes off all her bright dress and wears the ornament of forbearance at her neck.
ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
She receives great honour in this world and the next, and the whole world respects her.
ਓਹ ਰਲਾਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ. ਨਾ ਰਲੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
The one whom the Creator of all has met becomes unlike anyone else; her life becomes unique.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the bride who has the imperishable Lord as Husband and ever walks in the Guru's command is wedded for ever. ॥1॥
ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ, ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
Maya's bright colour is a dream of the night, a necklace worn without a thread;
ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
talk of God's praise, turning to the Guru, is the fast colour of madder.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੀ; ਸਭਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: the bride soaked in the supreme relish of the Lord's love has all her evils burnt to ash. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
Working wondrous plays, God Himself created this world,
ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ; ਮੋਹੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
and put in it the five elements, the root of attachment, falsehood and pride.
Caught in them, the ignorant self-willed person wanders and is born and dies.
ਇਕਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Some God has turned to the Guru and Himself given understanding of Himself,
ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
and has blessed them with the treasure of devotion and the Lord's Name. ॥4॥
ਸੂਹਵੀਏ. ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ; ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
O bride in love with the safflower's red, give up love of things that charm the mind; only then will you come to love your Husband-Lord.
787: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ. ਪਿਰੁ ਕਿਨੈ, ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦਝਿ ਮੁਈ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
No one has ever found the Husband-Lord through this bright colour; such a self-willed, foolish bride burns to death in its attachment.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਗਇਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
If the Guru is met and ego is removed from within, attachment to Maya's gaudy colour departs.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Mind and body are dyed red with the madder of the Name, and the tongue is dyed by recalling the Lord's virtues.
ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
The bride who has made her adornment through fear and love of the Lord, and in whose mind the Guru's Word dwells, becomes wedded for ever.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਮੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak: by the Lord's grace, keeping Him enshrined in the heart, His presence is attained. ॥1॥
ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸੂਹਾ ਪਰਹਰਹੁ; ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
O soul-bride, give up love of things that charm the mind, and make the adornment of the Lord's Name, the fast red colour.
Reflect on the Name through the Guru's Word, and the round of birth and death will end.
ਮੁੰਧ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
That bride is lovely and beautiful in whose heart-home, through spiritual poise, the Husband-Lord comes to dwell.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਐ; ਰਾਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: the wondrous Lord unites that bride with Himself. ॥2॥
ਮੋਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਰਤਾ ॥
In this world attachment, falsehood and entanglement prevail; the foolish self-willed person is dyed in them.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ; ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਲਿਤਾ ॥
Saying "I am great, this wealth is mine", the self-willed are ruined here, and at death they take nothing along.
ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿਤਾ ॥
Wandering in Maya, they do not see Death standing over their heads,
ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
and when Death seizes them, the lost time cannot be regained.
ਜੇਹਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਿਤਾ ॥੫॥
Beings act according to the destiny God has written on their foreheads from the start, in line with past deeds. ॥5॥
ਸਤੀਆ ਏਹਿ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਜੋ ਮੜਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਜਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
Those women are not called satis who burn themselves with their husband's corpse.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨੑਿ; ਜਿ ਬਿਰਹੇ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਨੑਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak: they should be known as satis who die from the blow of separation alone. ॥1॥
ਭੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ; ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
Those women too should be known as satis who live in faithfulness and contentment,
ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ; ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੰਨੑਿ ॥੨॥
who serve their husbands and ever remember this duty with zeal. ॥2॥
ਕੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ; ਸੇਤੀ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
True wives serve their husbands while they live and burn in the fire with them, that is, share with them in the world's joys and sorrows.
ਜੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
Because they regard the husband as their own, they bear bodily hardship.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
But, Nanak, those who never knew the husband as husband, why would they bear hardship?
ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਉ ਕੈ ਮਰਉ; ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Whether the husband is happy or in distress, they do not come near him in hard times. ॥3॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਲੇਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
O Creator, along with beings You created pain and pleasure, and wrote that destiny on their foreheads.
ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡ. ਹੋਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਿਆ ॥
There is no gift equal to the Name of the Lord, who has no particular form or feature.
ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
The Name is a treasure that never runs out; turning to the Guru, it dwells in the mind.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ. ਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
The one to whom God in His mercy gives the Name, He no longer writes the account of that person's good and bad deeds.
ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੬॥
But only those meet God who repeat the Lord's Name in the spirit of a servant. ॥6॥
ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
Those who have understood that they must leave do not spread their minds over the world's many affairs;
ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
but those busy only with settling worldly affairs give no thought to departing. ॥1॥
ਰਾਤਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ; ਭਲਕੇ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
If wealth is gathered only for the night, and in the morning one must set off,
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਚਲਈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, and that wealth cannot go along, one is left wringing one's hands. ॥2॥
ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੇ; ਨਾ ਗੁਣੁ. ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
Whatever is done under compulsion brings no good to oneself and no help to anyone else.
ਸੇਤੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Nanak: know that work as truly accomplished which is done gladly. ॥3॥
ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤਰਫ. ਨ ਜਿਪਈ; ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
However hard one labours, the Lord's side cannot be won by the mind's stubbornness;
ਤਰਫ ਜਿਣੈ, ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਦੇ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Servant Nanak: the one who brings good will and reflects on the Guru's Word wins that side. ॥4॥
ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
The Creator who made this world Himself knows how to care for it.
ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ; ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
He Himself created the world, and He Himself destroys it again.
788: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ; ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Since the world began, look as one may, no being has been able to tell the worth of God's greatness.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
The one to whom the Guru has shown the One has comfort in mind and body.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
Only through the Guru can the Creator, who can do all, be praised; whatever He does comes to pass. ॥7॥
ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ. ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ; ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ. ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥
Those who fear God fear nothing in the world; those without fear of God are gripped by great fear of the world.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਹੁ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ; ਤਿਤੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਗਇਆਹ ॥੧॥
Nanak: this verdict is made when a person reaches His court, that is, is joined to God's feet. ॥1॥
ਤੁਰਦੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਰਦਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਉਡਤੇ ਕਉ ਉਡਤਾ ॥
The walker keeps company with the walker, and the flier with the flier.
ਜੀਵਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ॥
The living-hearted meet the living-hearted and the dead-hearted the dead-hearted; each seeks the company of its own kind.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak: since the soul is of God's own essence, it should praise the Lord who made this world and join its mind to Him. ॥2॥
ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Those who, uplifted in thought through the Guru's Word, meditate on the eternal Lord become His very form.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Keeping the Lord's Name in the heart and killing ego, their minds become pure.
ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ; ਲਗਿ ਪਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
But fools become attached to houses, mansions and palaces.
ਜਿਨੑਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
Caught in the pitch darkness of attachment, the self-willed do not recognise the One who made them.
ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ, ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚਿਆ; ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
O eternal Lord, what are poor beings? Only the one You give understanding understands. ॥8॥
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ; ਜਾ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
O woman, adorn yourself only when you have first won over your husband;
ਮਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਏਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
otherwise the husband may not come to your bed at all, and the adornment goes to waste.
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਤਉ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
O woman, only when the husband's mind is pleased is the adornment truly made.
ਕੀਆ ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
A woman's adornment is accepted only if her husband loves her.
ਭਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਤਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ; ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
If the soul-bride makes living in the Lord's fear her adornment and betel relish, and makes His love her food, the support of her life,
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
and hands her body and mind over to the Husband-Lord, walking wholly in His will, then, Nanak, she meets Him. ॥1॥
ਕਾਜਲ ਫੂਲ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ; ਲੇ ਧਨ ਕੀਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
The woman took collyrium, flowers and betel relish and adorned herself,
ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਏਵੈ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
but if the husband did not come to her bed, the adornment became instead a torment of separation. ॥2॥
ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਹਿ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਬਹਨਿ; ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Those who merely sit together in body are not called wife and husband;
ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ; ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
those who are one soul in two bodies are truly called wife and husband. ॥3॥
ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Without the Lord's fear there can be no devotion, and no love for His Name.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
This fear arises only on meeting the Guru; through fear and love the colour of devotion is beautifully applied.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
With the help of the Lord's fear and love, killing ego and craving, mind and body are dyed in the colour of devotion.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ; ਭੇਟਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Meeting the Lord, mind and body become pure and very beautiful.
ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
This fear and love are all His gift; that eternal One Himself is present throughout the world. ॥9॥
ਵਾਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਤੂ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ॥
Blessed are You, O Master, blessed! You made the creation and created us.
ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਰ; ਵੇਲਿ ਵਰਸ ਵਰਾਹੁ ॥
The seas, the ocean's waves, the pools, the green creepers and the rain-bearing clouds — You made them all.
ਆਪਿ ਖੜੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ; ਆਪੀਣੈ ਆਪਾਹੁ ॥
Having made all, You Yourself pervade all, and are also apart from all.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ, ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ; ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਮਾਹੁ ॥
Practising Your Name with zeal, the labour of those who turn to the Guru is accepted at Your door.
ਮਸਕਤਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਮਜੂਰੀਆ; ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਸਮ ਦਰਾਹੁ ॥
Having laboured in devotion, O Master, they beg at Your door and receive their wages.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੁਰ ਦਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ; ਤਉ ਦਰਿ ਊਣਾ. ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ, ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak, say: O carefree Lord, Your doors are full of blessings; no one goes away empty from Your door; You are eternal and carefree. ॥1॥
ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਰਤਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੁੜੰਨਿ ॥
Bodies that shine with beautiful white teeth and lovely eyes, like gleaming pearls set with jewels —
ਤਿਨ ਜਰੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਥੀਇ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, old age is their enemy, for growing old they perish. ॥2॥
789: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Hand over body, mind and self to the Lord, living wholly in His will, and ever praise Him.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
The one who remembers Him through the Guru's Word meets the eternal Lord, profound and great of heart.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
In that person's mind and body the Lord, the diamond of diamonds, ever dwells.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਫੀਰੁ ॥
The pain of birth and death is removed, and that person does not have to go round the cycle again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
So, Nanak, you too remember the Name of the Lord, Master of virtues and great of heart. ॥10॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Nanak: this body, burnt in the fire of craving, has forgotten the Lord's Name; so end the body's attachment.
ਪਉਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਾਲਿ, ਪਿਛੈ ਹਥੁ. ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ; ਤਿਤੁ ਨਿਵੰਧੈ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
In this fallen heart-pool the straw of sins keeps piling up, and later no hand will reach to clear it. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ; ਫਿਟਿਆ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
Nanak: my mind's evil deeds are so many they cannot be counted.
ਕਿਤੀ ਲਹਾ ਸਹੰਮ; ਜਾ ਬਖਸੇ. ਤਾ ਧਕਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
Because of them I must bear many fears; when the Lord Himself forgives, one is not pushed away from His presence. ॥2॥
ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
Making the practice of remembering the Name the rule, God has issued this unshakeable command.
ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
That all-knowing Lord, who knows the good of each, is eternal and pervades all beings everywhere.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word the ideal of a life of remembrance is received; so, gaining the Guru's grace, let us remember Him.
ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ; ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
God has made the structure of remembrance complete, lacking nothing; following the Guru's teaching, enjoy the colour of remembrance.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧੧॥
God is unreachable, beyond the senses and unseen, yet turning to the Guru one comes to know Him. ॥11॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਦਰਾ ਮਾਲ ਕਾ; ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ॥
Nanak: a master's servant brings home the purse of money he has earned; so this trader-soul, sent here by the Lord, gathers the imprint of good and bad deeds.
ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
In the Master's court the false coins and the true are tested; in His presence it is sifted whether one earned falsehood or good. ॥1॥
ਨਾਵਣ ਚਲੇ ਤੀਰਥੀ; ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਤਨਿ ਚੋਰ ॥
If people go to bathe at pilgrimage places with a false mind, and the thieves of lust and the rest still dwell in the body,
ਇਕੁ ਭਾਉ ਲਥੀ ਨਾਤਿਆ; ਦੁਇ ਭਾ ਚੜੀਅਸੁ ਹੋਰ ॥
bathing removes one part, the outer dirt of the body, but twice as much dirt of pride and the rest settles on the mind.
ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੂਮੜੀ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
It is like the bitter gourd: washed on the outside, but within it remains pure poison.
ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ਅਣਨਾਤਿਆ; ਚੋਰ ਸਿ ਚੋਰਾ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
The good are good without bathing at pilgrimages, and thieves remain thieves even after bathing. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ; ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
God Himself runs His command, and He Himself has set the world to Maya's affairs.
ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Those whom He Himself has joined to the Name have found comfort in the Guru's refuge.
ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਦਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
This mind runs in all ten directions; the Guru alone has held back the mind of the one who came to him.
ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
All people long for the Lord's Name, but it is found only by taking the Guru's teaching.
ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ. ਨ ਸਕੀਐ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Meeting the Guru too is a matter of destiny; the writ the Lord has written on one's forehead from the start cannot be erased. ॥12॥
In the city of the world the moon and sun are like two lamps, and the fourteen realms are its bazaars.
All beings are the traders of this city.
When the shops opened, that is, when creation began, trading started.
Every trader who arrives here is only a traveller.
Righteousness, the broker, keeps marking each one's goods as true or false;
Nanak, only the profit of the Name is accepted at the Lord's shop.
The one who earns this profit and reaches His presence is greeted with joy,
and receives the honour of attaining the true Name. ॥1॥
ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ; ਸੁਪੇਦਾ. ਸੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
Nights are dark, yet white things keep their white colour; the night's darkness does not touch them.
ਦਿਹੁ ਬਗਾ ਤਪੈ ਘਣਾ; ਕਾਲਿਆ, ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
Day is white and shines brightly, yet black things keep their black colour; the daylight does not affect them.
ਅੰਧੇ. ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
So too, those who are blind, foolish and without sense keep their blind understanding.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ; ਕਬਹਿ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: those without the Lord's gracious glance never receive the honour of attaining the Name. ॥2॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
This human body is a fortress which the true Lord Himself has built.
ਇਕਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
Yet some, living in this fortress, He Himself has led astray in attachment to Maya, and they are caught in ego.
ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ. ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਸਾ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
This human birth was hard to obtain, but following their minds the self-willed suffer.
ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ. ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Only the one to whom the Lord gives understanding and whom the Guru blesses understands what this body was for.
ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ; ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ॥੧੩॥
No one can be blamed: God has made this whole world a play, and He Himself is present in it everywhere. ॥13॥
790: Thieves, lechers, adulterous women and procuresses sit and stand together;
ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
these people without faith keep friendship and share food among themselves.
ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥
They have no sense of praising the Lord; Satan, as it were, ever dwells in their minds.
ਗਦਹੁ. ਚੰਦਨਿ ਖਉਲੀਐ; ਭੀ ਸਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਣੁ ॥
Even when taught they do not learn: rub a donkey with sandalwood and it still rolls in ashes.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੂੜੈ ਕਤਿਐ; ਕੂੜਾ ਤਣੀਐ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Nanak: spinning the thread of falsehood, one must weave a warp of falsehood;
ਕੂੜਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਛੀਐ; ਕੂੜਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
one cuts and wears cloth of falsehood, and from this garment of falsehood one gains only false honour. ॥1॥
ਬਾਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਸਿੰਙੀਆ; ਨਾਲੇ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਲਾਣ ॥
The mullah calling to prayer, the fakir with his horn, the yogi with his singi, the bard with his praise-song all beg at people's doors;
ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ. ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
in the world there are many such beggars and many givers, but I need only Your Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਹਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: I am a sacrifice to those who have heard the Lord's Name and joined their minds to it. ॥2॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
Attachment to Maya is sheer deception, and in the end proves to be only deception.
ਹਉਮੈ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਝਗੜੈ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
But God, entangling beings in Maya, has set up the cycle of ego, and caught in it the world suffers.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓਨੁ; ਇਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
For the one who turns to the Guru, God Himself has ended this tangle; that person sees the One Lord pervading.
ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Such a person recognises the Supreme Soul everywhere and so crosses the world-ocean.
ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
That person's soul stays merged in the Supreme Light, joined to the Lord's Name. ॥14॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਭੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
O Guru, You are able to bless; give me the alms of the Name,
ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
so that my ego, pride, lust and anger may be removed.
ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
O Guru, may I receive from Your door the Lord's Name as life's support, and may my craving and greed be burnt away.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ; ਮੈਲਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
The Lord's Name is ever new day and night, the more one repeats it the more love grows; the Name is pure and is never soiled.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak: thus, by repeating the Name, one is freed from the cycle of ego. O Lord, this comfort comes through Your gracious glance. ॥1॥
ਇਕੋ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਬਾਈਆ; ਜਿਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
All the soul-brides standing at the Husband-Lord's door have the one Lord as their protector.
Nanak: those dyed in the Husband's love ask one another about His charming ways. ॥2॥
ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ; ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
All the brides are dyed in the Husband's love; in front of them, what account am I, the unfortunate one?
ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਏਤੜੇ; ਖਸਮੁ. ਨ ਫੇਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
My body has so many faults that the Master does not even turn His attention to me. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ; ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੈ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those in whose mouths is the Lord's praise.
ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਇਕ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੪॥
O Lord, You give all the nights to the wedded brides; give one night to me too, the forsaken one. ॥4॥
ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਤੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ॥
O Lord, I, a beggar, have come to Your door and beg for alms; in Your mercy give them to me.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ; ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
Turn me to the Guru and join me to Your feet, that I, Your servant, may obtain Your Name,
ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
that, fixing my soul in Your Light, I may sing the unbroken song of Your praise,
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
that I may sing in my heart Your virtues and the Bani of Your glory,
ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
and that, loving You, I may become sure that the Lord Himself is present everywhere in the world. ॥15॥
ਜਿਨੀ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ; ਕੰਤ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਉ ॥
The brides who did not enjoy the bliss of the Lord's love and did not taste union with the Husband-Lord
ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ; ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
went away empty from this human body, like a guest in a deserted house who leaves just as he came. ॥1॥
ਸਉ ਓਲਾਮੑੇ ਦਿਨੈ ਕੇ; ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਨੑਿ ਸਹੰਸ ॥
This soul receives a hundred reproaches for the evil deeds of the day, and thousands for those of the night,
ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ; ਕਰੰਗੀ ਲਗਾ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
for the soul-swan has abandoned the pearls of the Lord's praise and is busy feeding on the carrion of vice.
ਫਿਟੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ; ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੇਟੁ ॥
Shame on such a life, in which one only eats and fills the belly.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ; ਸਭੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: cut off from the eternal Name, all this attachment turns into an enemy. ॥2॥
ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ; ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
The minstrel ever sings the Lord's praises and makes his life beautiful;
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ; ਸਚਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
through the Guru, worshipping and praising the Lord, he enshrines the eternal Lord in his heart.
